sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_language" TEXT NOT NULL, "native_language" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_language_name" TEXT NULL, "native_language_name" TEXT NULL, "automatic_hint_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("automatic_hint_default" IN (0, 1)), "hint_default_offer_handled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hint_default_offer_handled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabulary_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "native_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "native_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "hint_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "example_target_text" TEXT NULL CHECK(example_target_text IS NULL OR length(example_target_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), "example_native_text" TEXT NULL CHECK((example_target_text IS NULL AND example_native_text IS NULL) OR (example_target_text IS NOT NULL AND example_native_text IS NOT NULL AND length(example_native_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)), "added_at" TEXT NULL, "hint_text" TEXT NULL CHECK(hint_text IS NULL OR length(hint_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000), "hint_visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'always' CHECK(hint_visibility IN ('always', 'hidden')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(length(trim(target_text)) > 0), CHECK(length(trim(native_text)) > 0), UNIQUE(collection_id, target_key, native_key, hint_key));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabulary_examples" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabulary_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0), "target_text" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(target_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), "native_text" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(native_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabulary_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "card_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(generation >= 0), "review_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(review_revision >= 0), "speed_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("speed_completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(id > 0), CHECK(direction IN ('targetToNative', 'nativeToTarget')), CHECK(format_version = 1), UNIQUE(entry_id, direction));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "regular_reviews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(length(id) > 0), CHECK(generation >= 0), CHECK(rating IN ('again', 'hard', 'good')), CHECK(substr(reviewed_at, -1) = 'Z'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "retry_obligations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "origin_review_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES regular_reviews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "wait_eligible_at" TEXT NULL CHECK(wait_eligible_at IS NULL OR substr(wait_eligible_at, -1) = 'Z'), "error_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(error_count >= 1), "due_ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20 CHECK(due_ordinal >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(length(trim(id)) > 0), CHECK(generation >= 0), CHECK(revision >= 0), UNIQUE(item_id, generation), CHECK(substr(created_at, -1) = 'Z'), CHECK(substr(expires_at, -1) = 'Z'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scope_answer_ordinals" ("collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection_id", "direction"), CHECK(direction IN ('targetToNative', 'nativeToTarget')), CHECK(ordinal >= 0), CHECK(revision >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_identity_sequence" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"), CHECK(singleton = 1), CHECK(next_id > 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabulary_order_sequence" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"), CHECK(singleton = 1), CHECK(next_row_id > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_dimensions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK(mode IN ('single', 'multiple')), CHECK(position >= 0), UNIQUE(collection_id, name_key), UNIQUE(id, collection_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_values" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES category_dimensions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK(length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK(position >= 0), UNIQUE(dimension_id, name_key), UNIQUE(id, dimension_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_group_preferences" ("tag_color_role" TEXT NULL, "dimension_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES category_dimensions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "custom_value_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("custom_value_order" IN (0, 1)), "carry_over" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("carry_over" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("dimension_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabulary_category_assignments" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "value_id"), FOREIGN KEY(entry_id, collection_id) REFERENCES vocabulary_entries(id, collection_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(dimension_id, collection_id) REFERENCES category_dimensions(id, collection_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(value_id, dimension_id) REFERENCES category_values(id, dimension_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "statistics_origins" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(singleton = 1), "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(substr(started_at, -1) = 'Z'), "learning_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(learning_date) = 10), PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "statistics_activity" ("credit_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('regular', 'speed')), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(substr(occurred_at, -1) = 'Z'), "learning_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(learning_date) = 10), PRIMARY KEY ("credit_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "speed_completion_receipts" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('targetToNative', 'nativeToTarget')), "completed_at" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(substr(completed_at, -1) = 'Z'), "learning_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(learning_date) = 10), PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "direction", "completed_at"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX vocabulary_entry_ownership ON vocabulary_entries (id, collection_id)
CREATE INDEX statistics_activity_date ON statistics_activity (learning_date, mode)
